```plato
// A curve measurable by arc length. ArcLength is the total length over the
// canonical domain; PointAtLength walks a distance along the curve from its
// start; ParameterAtLength converts a distance to the canonical parameter.
// TPoint is the concrete point type of the curve (Point2D, Point3D, or Number)
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Arc_length).
interface IArcLengthParameterized<TPoint>
{
    ArcLength(x: Self): Number;
    PointAtLength(x: Self, length: Number): TPoint;
    ParameterAtLength(x: Self, length: Number): Number;
}
```
